name: IGRA
description: Igra Network is an EVM-compatible Layer 2 blockchain built as a based rollup on Kaspa's BlockDAG architecture. Transaction sequencing is handled by Kaspa miners rather than a centralized sequencer, making transaction ordering permissionless and censorship-resistant by design. Igra executes EVM transactions on top of Kaspa's proof-of-work consensus, enabling Solidity-based smart contracts to operate within a decentralized settlement environment. The network uses two tokens: iKAS, a 1:1 KAS-wrapped gas token, and IGRA, used for attester staking and protocol governance. Igra Network v1 is deployed on mainnet as of early 2026 and smart contracts audited by Sigma Prime.
